review.title: Fixture review
review.summary: One source-backed issue requires tracked remediation.

findings.title: Untrusted HTML reaches a DOM sink

evidence.summary: The fixture assigns HTML directly to document.body.innerHTML.

findings.impact: Scriptable HTML can execute in the page context if the value becomes untrusted.
findings.fix: Render text or sanitize with an allowlist at a trusted boundary.
verification: Run an XSS regression test with event-handler and scriptable URL payloads.

unverified_risks.title: Input trust boundary is unknown
unverified_risks.gap: The fixture has no backend contract.
unverified_risks.verification: Trace the value to its production source and sanitization boundary.
